causal_question: Given the same verified pre-election evidence and the same frozen structural baseline, does constrained LLM residual reasoning improve territorial party vote-share forecasts beyond both no residual and a deterministic rule-only residual?

scientific_scope.interpretation_limit: The 2021 test is a component-level locked holdout for E_reason. It is not described as a pristine whole-system holdout because the structural Bstar family was previously selected using the 2016-to-2021 transition.

frozen_ancestry.rule: F-1, B2, F0 and every artifact below morocco26/data/goal100/e_collect at the exact parent commit are immutable. New E_reason artifacts are additive only.

conditions.description: Frozen structural Bstar forecast without any candidate/event residual.
Deterministic residual score computed only from the preregistered structured feature rubric.
One-pass constrained LLM ordinal residual judgment from the same anonymized evidence packet. No browsing, no names, no election year, no outcome access.
Optional genuine human-expert arm using the identical anonymized packet and output schema.
conditions.prohibition: Synthetic personas, LLM simulations of humans, or assistant guesses may never be labelled human judgments.

execution_order: Commit and validate this preregistration before any predictive judgment or forecast delta.
Collect and archive only pre-cutoff evidence.
Build complete 2016 and 2021 evidence packets with missingness explicit.
Create a secret random anonymization mapping; commit only its SHA-256 before judgments.
Freeze 2016 packets; generate C1 and C2 development judgments; calibrate residual scale on 2016 only.
Freeze 2021 packets and residual scales; generate C1 and C2 holdout judgments without outcome access.
Commit and hash all 2021 judgments before unsealing the 2021 outcomes.
Unseal, score, bootstrap, and issue a terminal promotion or no-promotion certificate.
Only if every promotion criterion passes may a separate 2026 application run create an F1 candidate. F0 is never overwritten.
forbidden_actions: Modify or rewrite F-1, B2, F0 or frozen E_collect artifacts.
Use any post-cutoff fact in a historical input packet.
Expose historical election year, real territory name, real party label, candidate name, result, winner, seat allocation or post-election description to C2.
Tune prompts, feature weights, residual grid, thresholds or scoring rules after viewing 2021 outcomes.
Drop low-coverage districts or party cells after outcomes are known.
Convert model confidence into factual verification.
Create or promote F1 after a failed or indeterminate gate.
